title: 第八章 弥彦第九章 四小第十章 木叶三忍一
lines: 夜天云这几日胸中有些沉闷，曾作为杀手的他对于未知的危机自然有着独特的感觉，心头越发的不安。这一切小南看见眼中，但她也隐隐猜到了夜天云心中所想，不想多言。
就这样，一个星期过去了，一切都是那么的寂静，但平静的外表下，别村的忍者已经悄悄潜入来到了雨忍村外。。。
“队长，前面就是雨忍村了，我们用不用。。。”一位忍者说道，头上的护额清晰的显露出他的身份--沙忍。
“不用，尽量绕过去，不要惊动他们，这是风影大人特别交代过的。”这名沙忍上忍扫了一眼不远处汪洋中的村落，低声说道。
可是，黑暗中，一道身影人影一闪而逝，消失的方向正是不远处的雨忍村。
“哼！！”半藏站了起来，呼吸机覆盖的面目让人无法得知此时的表情，但凌厉的眼神好似寒冰一般，透露出骇人的杀意。
“欺人太甚，边境已被搅得天翻地覆，沙忍竟然还敢潜入雨忍村腹地！！”由于呼吸器的缘故，使得半藏本身低沉的声音变得更加阴沉，充满了怒火。
半藏深吸了一口气，一个瞬身，消失不见。
沙忍此时正在缓缓前行，雨忍村外细雨绵绵，道路也泥泞不堪，沙忍的上忍队长也没有办法用更快的速度行军，只能祈祷雨忍没有发现他们的动向。然而，“嗖“的破空声响起，身边的一位同伴惨叫一声，倒了下去，后颈处插了几枚手里剑。
“小心，是雨忍，摆好阵型！！”沙忍上忍立刻反应过来，下达了命令。一时间，所有小队分别各自摆好了卍字阵型背靠着背，观察四周。
“踏踏“，一道道身影从路边灌木中闪现出来，将众多沙忍围在中间，双方对峙。
“半，半藏。。”沙忍们看清了雨忍领队的身影，不由得倒吸了口凉气，脊背发凉，心中又惊又怕，士气也略有下滑。正所谓无风不起浪，半神半藏的大名早已响彻忍界，他是真正立于忍界顶点的强者，可谓如日中天。
没有任何言语，没有任何准备，也没有任何征兆，半藏率先发难，杀入敌阵，怀着满腔怒火挥舞着手中的兵器。手中镰刀仿若死神的武器一般收割着沙忍的性命，所到之处便有沙忍死伤，血溅七步。
半藏的强势极大的鼓舞了雨忍的士气，纷纷掏出苦无与沙忍拼杀在一起。战场之中，水遁风遁的忍术层出不穷，虽然华丽无比，但实则凶险之极。惨叫声，喊杀声，充斥着整个战场。
半藏的长链勾镰舞动的变幻万千，诡异的轨迹令人防不胜防，避无可避，时不时配合水分身及水牢术击杀沙忍。虽然只是普通忍术的搭配，但半藏的时机掌握极好，在混战中杀伤力极为可观。
见到己方的伤亡越来越严重，沙忍的领队也是颇为血性，既然此行已经凶多极少，何不以死相拼，说不定还能杀出重围。沙忍的心思均是这般，反击也变得凶悍起来，雨忍虽然有半藏带领，但沙忍这边则有近十名上忍坐镇，双方斗了个旗鼓相当，一时间胜败难分。
另一侧，雨忍村外，一众木叶的忍者遥望着远处不时腾空的水龙、纷飞的风刃，静默不语。半晌，一道身影出现在众人面前，单膝跪地，恭声道：“队长，沙忍与半藏正在前方交战，战况激烈，没有三五个钟头恐怕不能结束。”
“告诉其他小队，夜袭雨忍村杀伤他们的有生力量以及物资。只是别恋战，否则半藏回归，就得不偿失了。”木叶的领队淡淡说道。
众人纷纷点头，一齐瞬身不见。
万家灯火，所剩无几，即便已经是休憩的时间，夜天云也坐在厅中桌旁。直觉告诉他今晚会有事情发生，以防万一自己不能轻易休息。
“砰“，突兀的爆炸声打破了雨忍村的宁静祥和，下一秒，村内各处烈焰吞吐，村民们纷纷从床上爬起来，逃出房外。
雨忍村的上空时不时划过一道道火光，如同红黄色的彗星闪耀天际。
木叶的忍者在村中各处布置了大量的起爆符，派遣擅长火遁忍术的忍者在远处打击村中的建筑物，由于半藏已经离开了村子，群龙无首，雨忍即便人数略占优势，但短时间内仍旧无法击退木叶忍者，让其在村中肆虐。
“天云，怎么了？”小南此时从房中跑出来，看着已经在收拾行装的夜天云，焦急的问道。
“战争来了，什么都别带，收拾些干粮，先出去避一避。”夜天云一边将干粮放进包中，一边说道。
小南虽然有些慌乱，但马上意识到了事态紧急，也与夜天云一同收拾包裹。外面的喊杀声、爆炸声却越来越频繁，两人不敢延误，冲出了房子。
content_en:
Ye Tianyun has been feeling a little depressed these past few days. As a former killer, he naturally has a unique feeling for unknown crises, and his heart is getting more and more uneasy. Xiaonan saw all this in her eyes, but she also vaguely guessed what Ye Tianyun was thinking and didn't want to say more.
In this way, a week passed, everything was so quiet, but under the calm appearance, ninjas from other villages had quietly sneaked outside the Rain Ninja Village. . .
"Captain, the Rain Ninja Village is ahead of us, do we need to..." said a ninja, and the forehead protector on his head clearly revealed his identity - Sand Ninja.
"No, try to go around and don't disturb them. This is what Master Kazekage has specially instructed." The sand ninja jonin glanced at the village in the ocean not far away and said in a low voice.
However, in the darkness, a figure flashed away, and the direction it disappeared was the Yu Ninja Village not far away.
"Hmph!!" Hanzo stood up, his face covered by a ventilator made it impossible to know his expression at this time, but his sharp eyes were like ice, revealing a terrifying murderous intention.
"This is too much bullying. The border has been turned upside down, and the sand ninja dares to sneak into the hinterland of the rain ninja village!!" Due to the respirator, Hanzo's deep voice became even darker and full of anger.
Hanzo took a deep breath, and disappeared in a flash.
The sand ninja was moving forward slowly at this time. It was drizzling outside the rain ninja village and the road was muddy. The sand ninja jounin captain had no way to march at a faster speed and could only pray that the rain ninja did not notice their movements. However, a "whoosh" sound broke through the air, and a companion beside him screamed and fell down, with several shurikens stuck in the back of his neck.
"Be careful, it's the Rain Ninja, get ready!!" The Sand Ninja Jonin immediately reacted and gave the order. For a moment, all the teams set up their own swastika formations, back to back, and observed their surroundings.
"Tap", figures appeared from the bushes on the roadside, surrounding many sand ninjas, and the two sides faced off.
"Half, half hidden..." When the sand ninjas saw the figure of the leader of the rain ninja clearly, they couldn't help but gasped, their spines went cold, their hearts were frightened and frightened, and their morale also dropped slightly. As the saying goes, there is no smoke without fire. The name of Demigod Hanzo has long been resounding in the ninja world. He is truly a strong man who stands at the top of the ninja world. It can be said that he is at the top of the world.
Without any words, without any preparation, and without any warning, Hanzo took the lead and charged into the enemy's position, brandishing the weapon in his hand with full fury. The scythe in his hand was like a weapon of death, harvesting the lives of sand ninjas. Wherever it went, sand ninjas were killed and injured, and their blood spattered every step of the way.
Hanzo's strength greatly boosted the morale of the rain ninja, and they all took out kunai and fought with the sand ninja. In the battlefield, there are endless ninjutsus such as Water Release and Wind Release. Although they are extremely gorgeous, they are actually extremely dangerous. Screams and shouts of death filled the entire battlefield.
Hanzo's long-chain hook dances in ever-changing patterns, and its weird trajectory is hard to guard against and unavoidable. From time to time, it is combined with water body and water prison techniques to kill the sand ninja. Although it is just a combination of ordinary ninjutsu, Hanzo has excellent timing and is extremely lethal in melee.
Seeing that their own casualties were getting more and more serious, the leader of the Sand Ninja team was also very bloody. Since this trip was already extremely dangerous, why not fight to the death and maybe break out of the siege. The Sand Ninja had this in mind, and their counterattacks became fierce. Although the Rain Ninja was led by Hanzo, there were nearly ten Jonin on the Sand Ninja's side. The two sides fought evenly, and it was hard to tell the winner for a while.
On the other side, outside the Rain Ninja Village, a group of Konoha ninjas looked at the water dragons and flying wind blades in the distance from time to time, silently. After a while, a figure appeared in front of everyone, knelt down on one knee, and said respectfully: "Captain, Sand Ninja and Hanzo are fighting at the front. The battle is fierce, and I'm afraid it won't end in less than three to five hours."
"Tell the other teams to attack the Rain Ninja Village at night to kill their manpower and supplies. Just don't be reluctant to fight, otherwise Hanzo will return and the losses will outweigh the gains." Konoha's team leader said calmly.
Everyone nodded and disappeared.
There were not many lights left in the houses. Even though it was already time to rest, Ye Tianyun was sitting at the table in the hall. His instinct told him that something would happen tonight, just in case he couldn't rest easily.
"Bang", the sudden explosion broke the peace and tranquility of Yuren Village. The next second, flames burst out everywhere in the village, and the villagers got up from their beds and fled out of the room.
From time to time, streaks of fire flashed across the sky above Yuren Village, shining like red and yellow comets in the sky.
The ninjas of Konoha placed a large number of detonating talismans throughout the village and sent ninjas who were good at fire escape ninjutsu to attack the buildings in the village from a distance. Since Hanzo had left the village and the group was leaderless, the rain ninjas, even if they had a slight numerical advantage, were still unable to repel the Konoha ninjas in a short time and allowed them to wreak havoc in the village.
"Tianyun, what's wrong?" Xiaonan ran out of the room at this time, looked at Ye Tianyun who was already packing, and asked anxiously.
"The war is coming. Don't bring anything with you. Pack some dry food and go out for a while." Ye Tianyun said while putting the dry food into his bag.
Although Xiaonan was a little panicked, he immediately realized the emergency and packed the package with Ye Tianyun. The shouts of death and explosions outside became more and more frequent. The two of them rushed out of the house without delay.
